title: Duke adds men to the band
summary: They try to recall when Tizol and Lawrence Brown joined, the first expansions, and when Ben Webster arrived.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: That's right. Well, Cootie, let's see. That takes us to, I think about -- well, that was in '33. So in '34, let's start to think when Duke started to put some more people in the band. Now, I don't know how well we're going to
do about dates here, but when he started to augment the band, because -- for instance, when you went with the band, was Artie in it then?
Oh. And sort of being the three -- you mean, they toured with Bubber?
I had taken Bubber Miley's place.
Yeah. So there were three trumpets and the one trombone.
Well, it seems to me that one of the first people he put on was Lawrence.
Lawrence? No, I think it was Tizol, wasn't it? I can't recall which one came first.
I remember Lawrence made that 'Shiek of Araby,' remember?
That caused a lot of talk.
Well, let's see. The four saxophones. It was quite a while before Ben came in the band.

That was quite a long while, I think, because I think that was around 1940 that Ben first came in the band, I believe. But, let's see, who else? When did Freddy drop out of the band? Can you remember?
I don't recall when Freddy dropped out of the band. I don't remember.
Well, I know he was there when you went to England.
I think his wife was taken real sick, and that's the reason why he quit.
